title: Inazuma Eleven Cross Game Launches for iOS, Android on June 9
content: Level 5 and Aiming announced at the Inazuma Eleven : Grand Strategy Showcase on Friday that the Inazuma Eleven : Cross game will launch for iOS and Android on June 9. The Japan National Team 2026 Project will feature new commemorative artwork and add Mark Evans (Mamoru Endo in Japanese) and Jude Sharp (Yuto Kido in…
author: ANN

title: Nickelodeon Animator Drops Out of A.I. Program Following Backlash
content: Jorge R. Gutierrez has made a big name for himself in the animation industry, working on projects such as El Tigre: The Adventures of Manny Rivera , Maya And The Three , and El Macho . In the future, the animator is planning to enter the world of Looney Tunes with a Speedy Gonzalez movie.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece TV Anime's Elbaph Arc Reveals Trailer, Cast for Knights of God
content: The official X/Twitter account for the One Piece anime revealed on Friday a video and the cast members for the Knights of God: The newly announced cast members are: • Sumire Uesaka as Gunko • Hiroki Yasumoto as Sommers • Shinnosuke Tachibana as Killingham Kenjirō Tsuda was previously confirmed to play Shamrock.
author: ANN

title: Dokodemo Young Champion Digital Manga Magazine Ends Publication
content: The editorial staff of Akita Shoten 's Dokodemo Young Champion digital manga magazine announced in the magazine's June issue (seen right) on Tuesday that the magazine will cease publication, and the June issue is the magazine's final issue.
author: ANN

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End’s Real World Event Brings Tears to Voice Actors’ Eyes
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has wasted little time in becoming one of the biggest new anime series on the market. The immortal elf’s anime adventures, forged by Studio Madhouse, have two seasons under its belt, with a third on the way as it skyrockets in popularity.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga UP! Global Adds Karino Takatsu's Owl Night Manga
content: Manga UP! Global launched in English on Friday Karino Takatsu 's Owl Night manga . The company describes the story: When 20-year-old college student Eichi Usaki makes up his mind to visit the nightlife district, he gets a mysterious solicitation!
author: ANN

title: Exclusive: Abrams ComicArts' Kana Shares Preview Pages for Naoki Urasawa, Takashi Nagasaki's Billy Bat Manga
content: Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint shared on Friday preview pages for its release of Naoki Urasawa and Takashi Nagasaki 's Billy Bat manga. The company will release the first volume in English on June 2, and it plans to release four volumes per year.
author: ANN

title: One Piece Holy Knights Trailer Introduces Shamrock, Gunko, Sommers & Killingham
content: ONE PIECE revealed a new trailer introducing the Holy Knights, introducing the voice cast for Shamrock, Gunko, Sommers and Killigham. Episode 1164 is set to premiere on Sunday, May 31.
author: Anime Corner

title: K Manga Adds Ema Toyama's A Thousand Years Behind the Veil Manga
content: Kodansha 's K MANGA platform announced on Thursday that it has added Ema Toyama 's A Thousand Years Behind the Veil ( Sen-nen no Hanayome ) manga and Aika and Meshiko Iida 's The Tale of How My Cheap, Stingy Sister-in-Law Lost It All ( Sekokechi Gimai ga Subete o Ushinatta Hanashi ) manga in English.
author: ANN

title: Solo Leveling Sets a Record No Anime Has Ever Achieved on Crunchyroll
content: It has now been a little over two years since the Solo Leveling anime made its debut on Crunchyroll, and in that short span of time, the anime has secured a position on the platform that no other anime ever has. Ever since its debut, Solo Leveling has continued its trend of capturing attention and breaking records.
author: ComicBook
